title: Oxygen-rich carbon cloth as a lithium deposition host for stable lithium metal anodes
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,12372-12381
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01479D, Paper
Open Access

Yan Wang, Chunxiao He, Xiaodong Sun, Xianyu Liu
Oxidized carbon cloth (OCC) modified with oxygen-containing functional groups (–COOH, –C–OH) as a host framework can guide homogeneous deposition of Li and restrain Li dendrite growth.
